notes.title: Shrimp Keeping Simulator 2.0 is here!
notes.content:
Shrimp Keeping Simulator 2.0
I realize this game was pretty low effort on release. So I did some stuff to make it more fun and have more content!


Changelog:
Color breeding system

Breed your shrimp to get unique colors

Changed selling systems to make it work with the new features

More stuff to place

Driftwood

Floaters

Temperature system

New tutorial

Fixed a game breaking bug related to food loading



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481013/a06e6e849e2a9d813871ff4b4d068b73a589710b.png"]
Let me know if you have more ideas
